business_purpose: Used to track and report credit notes details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Accounts & Finance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the credit notes details view.

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Use Total_credit_amount for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns type, Category, status classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Vw_CreditNotesDetails is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.
common_queries: Credit Notes Details count by type
Total total credit amount by month

known_issues: Total_credit_amount is stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
Total_credit_amount is nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.
Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name Vw_CreditNotesDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use SUM(Total_credit_amount) for totals of total credit amount.
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
